name: Uwajima Iyo
source: Iyo is from Ehime Prefecture; her name comes from Iyo, Ehime, and Uwajima, Ehime. Despite being eighteen-years-old, she comes off as an older gyaru-like girl. She is the eldest of four sisters and likes to look after her younger siblings. She has the tendency to get wild ideas and can be seen as unreliable.
